rows.en: You damn bugs!
Why don't you understand? This is the ultimate form of human evolution!
Ah... my... our dream...
I'm being beaten... by vermin like these?!
It was supposed to be the power to rule the entire universe... So why?
The whole galaxy is in my hands.
The door to the abyss opens.
Ah... I feel it... I feel it...
So this is the power of song?
No... our dream... Our dream, defeated by a mere song...
Impossible! Our plan, hindered by a mere song!
Time's up. I'm detonating the Dimension Eater. Purple One, return at once, and keep following my orders.
rows.notes: Spoken as a commander (male-style 'da'); Dimension Eater and Purple One not in glossary beyond Purple Flight.

rows.en: Apostles of the Galactic Fairy: the fleet is destroyed. Hatred burns. The fold waves are their guide. Good luck, Frontier.
rows.notes: Whisper transcript is garbled and run together (15 s); meaning reconstructed, wording loose.

rows.en: I never imagined this girl was the Little Queen.
Can you see, Ranka? Those who would violate this planet are attacking.
Futile struggling.
Listen, vermin! We now hold the whole universe, through the Vajra: life the Protoculture feared, envied and mimicked!
rows.notes: Long line compressed to fit 178 bytes; 'shinka shite sono sugata o mo shita' is ambiguous about who imitates whom.

rows.en: Know our power!
Songs mean nothing to us, who are directly linked to the Queen.
Go, Vajra! My eyes, my ears, my limbs, with your mighty claws!
Why don't you understand? This is the ultimate form of human evolution!
You damn vermin!
That's why we...!
How could this be?
Impossible.
rows.notes: Transcript 'ariana-ibaa' (garbled); same slot as 'ariemasen/arienai wa' in the other variant.

rows.en: Die.
Damn it!
Insolent.
Now, kneel! Before my power, equal to a god's, that rules even fate!
rows.notes: Transcript 'hikyou shinasai / umeki' garbled; read as 'hirefuse' and 'unmei' as in 106/608.

rows.en: Vermin, wasting your effort.
Defying me... what a foolish child.
Futile struggling!
You're better than I expected.
You've got enough power to amuse me, I suppose.
Why don't you understand? This is the ultimate form of human evolution!
Ah... my... our dream...
I'm being beaten... by vermin like these?!
It was supposed to be the power to rule the entire universe... So why...?
rows.notes: Kanji for 'slide' read as the homophone for 'rule'.

Hmph, futile struggling.

rows.en: Songs mean nothing to us, who are directly linked to the Queen.
Now, kneel! Before my power, equal to a god's, that rules even fate!
Go, Vajra! My eyes, my ears, my limbs, with your mighty claws!
You damn vermin!
That's why we...
Looks like launch prep is complete. Launching!
Jeffrey Wilder, sortieing.
Never thought I'd sortie as a pilot again.
Too soft!
They think little of me.
Weak!
What the...!
I must recover at once!
I've got to shake off this rust.
One more!
This one's going to hurt!
Now!
What?!
You got me, I'll give you that.
rows.notes: 'yatte kureru': annoyed or admiring; read as grudging respect.

rows.en: No problem.
Did I let my guard down?
It only grazed me.
I've still got more!
I won't miss this opening!
Sorry about that.
Everyone, show your full strength!
Sadly, this is no exercise. Battle stations.
I'll show you how a veteran fights.
This takes me back to my youth.
Going into intercept mode.
Target acquired.
